value.title: Thin complete CLI and actionable outcomes
value.success: Implement the complete 27-leaf grammar and injected query frontend, mount docs, preserve config/catalog/legacy list/export, and add useful next actions plus actionable errors to every outcome. Keep matching/reconstruction/privacy/stats in QueryApi; render through injected QueryWriter. Own create-new staging/publication and stream/error routing.
value.notes: Guide unit: tk-000b; wave 2; owner role coder. Exact paths/reads/interfaces/dependencies: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-000b. Approved decomposition receipt: ../../team/review-decomposition-approved.dd.json. Wave2 consumes committed docs/output deliveries, uses FakeQueryApi and actual output adapter in tests rather than waiting for SDK engine. Delete directly affected wording/implementation-pinning tests instead of re-pinning prose. Git-note specific frontend changes are a PM convergence boundary after the owner handoff. Skip validation while concurrent. Named routing acceptance: catalogue sessions list --repo . --harness claude-code reaches QueryApi; --source-adapter git-ai selects query facts; --adapter git-ai --repo selects the existing native note listing; --root selects native JSONL listing; sessions export preserves native OTLP. Reject mixed forms with actionable guidance, and preserve semantic data/streams while adding next-action metadata. CSV schema/loss diagnostics direct availability-sensitive consumers to JSON/JSONL. The routing regression matrix is owned here, not inferred solely from one primary example per catalogue leaf; explicitly cover query --source-adapter git-ai versus native --adapter git-ai, legacy --root and all rejected mixtures. PM quality acceptance is mandatory: candidate code is inspected for correctness, maintainability and needless allocations/duplication, exercised through applicable composed behavior and independently reviewed. A compile or coder completion claim is not acceptance.

tk-0001.assertion: All declared formats expose the documented shapes and units; JSONL remains row-only and OTLP is never represented as query JSON.
CSV escaping, terminal/Markdown controls and nested projections do not bypass content consent or serialize hidden raw data.
Counted writes, flush/broken-pipe failures and partial destinations cannot produce a completed result/checkpoint.
Raw data streams contain no next-action banners or fake summary rows.
CSV format capabilities and diagnostics explicitly name absent/null/empty losses and guide exact-availability consumers to JSON/JSONL.

tk-0002.assertion: Bundled topic/schema discovery works without runtime config, source stores, Git or network.
Every command has meaningful use cases and each of seven recipes has real argv, expected interpretation, limits, recovery and next steps.
Topic links resolve and example commands/SDK sources are checked against actual parser/schema/public APIs, not a duplicate registry.
Examples are synthetic and evidence-qualified; private reports and unauthorized transcripts are absent.
Docs steer successful, empty and failed interactions to useful supported next steps rather than generic dead ends.

tk-0003.assertion: The one real root parser sends --root and legacy --adapter forms to native handlers, --source-adapter forms to QueryApi, and rejects mixed forms without default-adapter fallback; all 27 leaves and old native semantic data/streams remain valid.
Output-mode conflicts are rejected; row selection does not change with TTY and raw data channels stay clean.
Output files are staged/create-new and failures leave existing destinations/source stores intact.
Each success/zero/partial/help/version/export outcome emits a useful parser-valid action; required inputs and privacy consent stay explicit.
All error families yield safe cause-specific alternatives/retry conditions, with best-effort diagnostics and nonzero exit on write failure.
Cursor mismatch reasons remain machine-visible and generate cause-specific safe next actions, not a generic source-changed message.

value.approach: Use each assertion's selected pressure and the exact guide check; no unexecuted test or imported commit is runtime proof.
value.phase_boundary: Real parser, serializer and frontend behavior with shared core facts and then SDK composition; no assertion that authored fixtures alone prove an installed binary.
value.concurrency: No build/test/lint/formatter while concurrent edits are in flight; PM executes final composed lanes and targeted fixes.
value.proof_grades: Existing boot proves native projections only. BUILD/EXTEND checks must be implemented and run before assertions become checked.
